verified: CATL unveiled a 100 kWh passenger-car battery pack called “30#” for its swapping network in China, which the company says can be exchanged in about a minute and can also be fast-charged at ordinary charging stations, electrive reported on 27 November; Chinese and specialist outlets covering the same launch (CarNewsChina, Interesting Engineering) attribute the 99-second swap figure, a 700 km CLTC range and a lifetime warranty for packs in the network to CATL.
unconfirmed: everything beyond capacity and the two use modes rests on CATL's own presentation — the 700 km CLTC range, 99-second swap, 600 kW peak discharge, a 3-second 0–100 km/h sprint and a 27-year locking-mechanism lifespan have not been independently tested, and the reports leave out battery chemistry, which vehicle models are compatible, pack price, and when or where the pack will be deployed; the sources also conflict on swap time, with electrive saying “under a minute” while the other outlets report 99 seconds, which is just over one minute.

verified: 据 electrive 报道，宁德时代发布面向中国换电体系的“30#”电池块，容量为 100 kWh，换电时间不到一分钟，也可在常规充电站快充。
unconfirmed: 99 秒换电、600 kW 峰值放电、3 秒级零百加速、约 700 公里（435 英里）CLTC 续航、锁止机构 27 年理论寿命等说法，都来自其他媒体报道或转述宁德时代的宣称；网络内电池终身质保仅见于单一报道。这些均无独立测试验证，车辆适配、部署时间和价格也未公布。

titles.en: CATL unveils 100 kWh '30#' swappable battery for passenger cars
